{{Quote|I'm Zola Arvannus, Diplomatic Service, on assignment to the Mandalorian settlement.|Zola Arvannus, regarding [[Outpost Rennar]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Zola Arvannus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] residing in the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Outpost Rennar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She asked another Imperial individual to remove a group of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] from their nearby [[Gamorrean Bunker|hideout]] so that the Empire could move there instead.<ref name="TOR" />
